reviews.text: Great pet store

Goldmine in the heart of Fulham!
Excellent choices of fishes & accessories  but most of PLATINUM service !

Our local expert pet shop, friendly and always has time to be kind.  They stock great affordable toys, treats and raw food for my cockapoo.   Part of our community.  They have a the best fish department downstairs, tropical fish to boot.  Now open on Sundays 10am-3pm

Always helpful knowledgeable and with the pets interest at the heart of everything they do. Absolutely lovely people in a lovely pet shop . I recommend them unreservedly . My dog Frank is disabled and they are very accommodating of his needs and wants 😍 …
Healthy fish and Tyler is very helpful in picking fishes!
Good
The best deals for pet foods and my budgie loves their budgie tonic and seeds mix, very good value for your money and so very nice friendly people 💯 …

Wonderful pet shop I’m so impressed! Excellent selection for aquatics and more, and great pricing to match! The staff were so friendly and helpful, especially my man in the fish area downstairs (so sorry I never got your name!). I can’t wait to go back for more!
I love this little shop . Team is so friendly and helpful
Supportive and friendly staff. Found what is was looking for.
Friendly and helpful, nice selection of fish, plants and all aquarium accessories, very enjoyable time spent there today 😊 …
Absolutely brilliant being there today, the young man in the fish department was so knowledgeable and polite and well presented. Defo my fave place to stock my 5 aquariums from 🥰 …
This place is horrible and the employees we're so rude!! I do not recommend buying here

Best pet shop ever.
All staff are very friendly and knowledgeable.
Jen, the owner is lovely
Very kind staff. I visit regularly with my son and the visit is usually the highlight of his week.
These guys are great! Thank you Emma for all the help & support you provided me over the weekend, and for provided a new home for my goldfish that was chasing my other goldfish. I appreciate you
Tyler was extremely helpful and patient with helping me choose the right fish for my tank, go to him for excellent service!

I recently bought 2 bunnies from here,these bunnies were in terrible condition once I brought them home.matted all over their stomach,pee stains everywhere and extremely long nails.though these bunnies were friendly and slightly tamed the state they were in was not okay.at this point they will have to be brought to the vets in order to get this dealt with.i wouldnt be surprised if the fur will have to be cut.not to mention the cages all of the animals are kept in are so tiny.i was also lied to about the age of the rabbits.told the day before they were 6 months and then all of a sudden they were 8-9 months?!absolutely terrible,do not reccomend.the birds were in a terrible state too.losing feathers,lied to about the age of one of the birds there too.so not support this terrible place.

They have lots of choices of fish but the staff are very confusing. My son wanted a turtle but the employees downstairs said they don’t have them but they have a tortoise upstairs. So we went upstairs and the staff upstairs said they DID have turtles and that it was downstairs but they didn’t have turtles. In the end, we bought nothing
Very friendly the people were very informative

The Fish Bowl Fulham it is the best shop to go around and also the oldest, here you can find things for all kind of pets and the staffs and owners are kind and here to help you and honests to guide you.
Thank you to all for help me all the time, that I'm still learning about my cats 🙏
Amazing place super friendly and very helpful would defo recommend for everyone !!!!

Friendly shop with helpful advice when we bought three new goldfish for our small garden pond. After two weeks reclusive behaviour, they are now happily out and about, thanks to the The Fish Bowl’s careful instructions. Thank you.

This establishment offers a comprehensive selection of aquatic life and related accessories. The staff possesses considerable expertise in fish care and equipment, making it a highly recommended resource.

WARNING - PEST SNAILS -

I did very well to purchase from reputable aquariums until I went here and got pest snails from their plants!

Phoned up to let them know and I’m expected to pay for assassin snails to remedy the pest snails they gave me unwillingly.

Not only do I have hundreds of pest snails in my new tank I have two types of them!

When I phoned to ask apparently it’s absolutely fine they came with the plants and I should have expected it.

Had I known it was a risk I wouldn’t have bothered purchasing anything with them and continued to buy products with a reputable aquarium who quarantine their stock!

Hi went there to look at the fish and have a good different selection of fish, and some African dwarf frogs and snakes and others downstairs and upstairs rabbits, and other animals and alot of toys leads and bits for dogs and cats nice people aswell 👍 …
Lovely shop lovely staff and cheaper than Amazon.

I used to shop at this store 10 years ago when I lived in London.
Remembered the shop now, and googled to see if this shop is still there… amazing shop.
I wanted to get a snake but they didn't had a tank for snakes... it's like going to buy a car without wheels...how are you going back home?...it was for a birthday

I wanted to buy a hamster there and I had a massive cage for it and everything for the hamster however that old lady there wouldnt let me buy one after showing her the cage she said it was too small I couldn't buy it

Extremely disappointing service. The staff were incredibly rude and unprofessional throughout my visit. There is absolutely no excuse for such behavior—basic politeness and courtesy should be standard in any customer-facing role. Unfortunately, this was completely lacking here. I would not recommend this place to anyone. It’s clear that the staff could benefit from proper training in customer service and respectful communication.
It is a very good shop and it has a large selection of fish and plants

Comprehensive range of pet supplies, pet food etc.
Large fish/aquarium  section in the basement.
Very unwelcoming not friendly at all would never go back to this shop we walked out without buying
Amazing prices and amazing customer service I bought a huge tank for £30 120 liters

I have shopped here for decades. First as a child, then for my son when he was young and now for myself. I have always found them helpful and pleasant. HOWEVER I recently had a horrible experience when I went in to buy fish medicine from downstairs and tried to pay at the till. The till kept rejecting my card, and I told the cashier it was due to poor connection ( it said as much on the machine!) I then said that I would pay upstairs and went up the stairs. As I arrived at the top of the stairs the phone rang and was put on loud speaker.  The girl downstairs proceeded to say " there's a lady coming up she hasn't paid". I responded "I'm here already! I am not going to run away without paying!" The lady then went on to say no, she didn't mean that blah blah blah! When I got to the front of the queue, I took the items out of the bag to be scanned, and the lady said, "Don't worry" and rang up the exact price! I let them know that I was made to feel like a thief and that I didn't appreciate what was done and they tried to gaslight me and say she was being helpful.
I am really disappointed with the service I received and am reluctant to continue using the shop.
amazing place , so many different animals and everything to them. really good place
Great service and lovely fish! We got our baby turtle there and he’s thriving.
Great service and very personable

Absolutely fantastic staff, very knowledgable. The shop is well stocked. I went to a few places to compare before committing to my purchase, and by far this shop had the best prices (even vs online) and products
Best fish shop ever you can buy fish for as cheap as £1 and the ladies are very nice
Loved visiting this shop! Staff was very kind and helpful!
Lovely customer service and knowledgeable staff! We just bought our kids their first pet fish and the whole experience at The Fish Bowl made it very special for them. Many thanks!
Great choice of fish and equipment. Excellent knowledgeable friendly service.  I will definitely be back

A wonderful pet shop with very helpful and lovely staff. I couldn’t believe how big it was and the variety of products available. I went to browse the fish section for filter service kit which was very reasonably priced. They have a huge selection of fish products and a big range of fish for sale. Very impressed, will be returning soon!

This wonderful local shop in Fulham is an amazing resource for all types of pets not just fish. Downstairs they have a large collection of fish available for sale while upstairs is where you’ll find toys puzzles harnesses pet food both fresh and frozen and all sorts of treats for your cats and dogs Right now they have an amazing selection of Christmas themed toys. It’s much nicer to go there in person down to shop online for such items the three ladies who run the shop are really wonderful and the whole place has a happy vibe to it. Please support your local shops. You’ll find the selection much better than online sites and the person with service and helpful advice they give is really fantastic.
Very helpful

Absolutely lovely place to stop off and visit. loads of fish, reptiles, birds, hamsters and even ants! The staff are all very lovely and welcoming....prices aren't bad at all either I definitely recommend this pet store!!

I came to this shop looking for everything a bunny would require with no knowledge, the ladies in the shop were extremely helpful, knowledgeable and friendly. Absolutely 5 start service. Thank you so much!
Good assortment, friendly staff. I like this shop. Thanks!

Absolutely AMAZING shop. I'm disappointed at myself for not discovering this hidden gem of a shop years before. They have a wonderful selection of various fishes. Staff are very friendly, I hope Emma didn't mind me asking so many questions, but a big thanks to her and her expertise, she was very helpful.
I will say, if your after tropical fishes and your in central London or zone 2, then This is amongst the best.
Reasonable prices and fantastic choices.

I love the staff here, I am always popping in with constant questions and they are always so helpful, nice and very informative,    Emma should be fed up with me by now so big shout ot to her ;) we love our new Betta fish.
Experienced staff very helpful
I go here often for food for my reptiles, get new fish and see the animals!
Really nice set up, good range of fish. Price is a bit expensive. Friendly staff.
Nice shop held by true animal lovers
Have different kinds of pets and related products for choosing.
Great and amazing place that including fish and reptiles here. Very good experience 👍👍❤️❤️ …
Nice staff good selection of products
Nice and friendly and they have a great collection of fish.
